[USER] The user needs help setting up automatic backups for their working files.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a guide for setting up automatic backups using an external hard drive.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Materials needed for backups include: an external hard drive (at least 1-2 TB of storage space recommended), a computer with a USB port, and backup software.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested backup software options include: Time Machine (for Mac), Backup and Restore (for Windows), Acronis True Image, and Duplicati.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Steps for setting up Time Machine on a Mac include: going to System Preferences > Time Machine, selecting the backup disk, setting backup frequency, and customizing backup settings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Steps for setting up Backup and Restore on Windows include: going to Control Panel > System and Security > Backup and Restore, selecting the backup location, choosing files to back up, and saving settings to run the backup.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for verifying backups include checking the external hard drive and regularly verifying that backups complete successfully.  
[USER] The user will use Time Machine on their Mac and will follow the provided steps.
